name: World of Warships: Legends
summary: 主机端海战射击移植 PC 的免费作品，2026 年 5 月 4 日上市。Wargaming 披露生成式 AI 只在开发期用于补充性、非核心目的，点名单元检测与“某些美术元素”的制作，产出经团队复核，并称最终核心素材与游戏内容全部由自家美术与开发完成。

aiAreaNotes.ingame: 开发者自述“所有最终核心素材与游戏内容完全由 Wargaming 的美术与开发人员创作”，属人工制作的自述，未经独立核实。
aiAreaNotes.code: 披露把单元检测列为生成式 AI 的用途之一，属开发期/代码与工具环节；自述范围有限、非核心且经过团队复核。
aiAreaNotes.art: 披露称生成式 AI 也用于“creation of certain art elements”，同时限定为补充性、非核心、范围有限并由团队复核；开发者另称最终核心素材全部由自家美术完成。

sources.label: Steam 商店完整 AI 披露
sources.excerpt: Generative AI is used solely during development for supplemental, non-essential purposes, including unit testing or the creation of certain art elements. These AI-generated outputs are limited in scope, reviewed by our development team, and never substituted human creative or technical decision-making. All final core assets and game content are created entirely by Wargaming’s artists and developers.

sources.label: Steam 讨论区首页核查
sources.excerpt: 英文讨论区首页显示 15 个主题（总数 164）；仅覆盖首页。

sources.label: HowMuchAI 按部件拆解本作披露的分析页
sources.excerpt: Generative AI was used in development for unit testing and some art elements, reviewed by the team; final core assets are human-made.

sources.label: AI Transparency Index 复刻本作商店披露的分析页
sources.excerpt: Generative AI was used during development for non-essential purposes like unit testing and art elements, with no disclosed AI output in the final game.

reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商与发行商同为 Wargaming Group Limited）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 164），首页没有与 AI 使用直接相关的主题，未逐帖展开。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记 6 条结果，读取 2 篇原始来源（HowMuchAI 按部件拆解本作披露的分析页，把披露未提及的部件标为未说明；AI Transparency Index 复刻商店披露的分析页，结论是最终游戏里没有已披露的 AI 产出）。两者都是对商店披露的转录或模型再分类，不构成独立核实。其余结果为本作商店页、发行方员工在 LinkedIn 的 PC 版上线复盘帖、指向另一 App ID（3805560）的 Steam 鉴赏家页与读不到正文的 Reddit 帖。领域判定全部来自商店披露原文，结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计；“某些美术元素”既未逐项列出也未说明是否进入正式版，游戏内成品按开发者自述记为“称未使用”。本作为免费游玩、含内购。
disclosureQuote: Generative AI is used solely during development for supplemental, non-essential purposes, including unit testing or the creation of certain art elements. These AI-generated outputs are limited in scope, reviewed by our development team, and never substituted human creative or technical decision-making. All final core assets and game content are created entirely by Wargaming’s artists and developers.
disclosureQuoteNote: Steam 商店 AI 生成内容披露栏完整原文，2026-11-03 核查；可能随商店页更新。

english.summary: The console naval shooter brought to PC as a free-to-play title, released on May 4, 2026. Wargaming states that generative AI was used solely during development for supplemental, non-essential purposes, naming unit testing and the creation of certain art elements, that those outputs were limited in scope and reviewed by the team, and that all final core assets and game content are created entirely by its own artists and developers.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer and publisher Wargaming Group Limited) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 164); no homepage topic directly concerns AI use and individual threads were not opened. This title was searched 1 time with 6 results and 2 raw sources were read: a HowMuchAI page that breaks the disclosure down part by part and marks the parts the text does not mention as not mentioned, and an AI Transparency Index page reproducing the disclosure and concluding there is no disclosed AI output in the final game. Both work from the store text itself, so they are transcriptions or model reclassification rather than independent verification. The remaining results were the store page, a LinkedIn post by a publisher employee about the PC launch, a Steam curator page for a different App ID and a Reddit thread with no readable body. Every area finding comes from the store disclosure text itself and rests on the developer's own statement, without an independent audit; the certain art elements are never itemised and the disclosure does not say whether any of them shipped, so the in-game area follows the developer's own statement of non-use. The title is free to play with purchases.

aiAreaNotes.ingame: The developer states that all final core assets and game content are created entirely by Wargaming's artists and developers; this is a human statement about non-use in the shipped game and was not independently verified.
aiAreaNotes.code: The developer lists unit testing among the supplemental, non-essential purposes generative AI was used for during development, which is a development-time and code-adjacent use rather than shipped content.
aiAreaNotes.art: Certain art elements are named as created with generative AI, but bounded by the developer's wording as supplemental, non-essential, limited in scope and reviewed by the team.
aiAreaNotes.music: This area is not addressed by the reviewed disclosure; that is not proof of non-use.
